_notes: Episode 5: original rule 'If your elevator ever stops on a floor you didn't press'. Glow characters, American narrator. cap: *bright*, !red!, {TEXT:N}.

lines.tts: If your elevator ever stops on a floor you didn't press,
lines.cap: If your elevator ever stops on a floor you !didn't! !press,!

lines.tts: The doors will open onto a hallway that looks exactly like yours.
lines.cap: The doors will open onto a hallway that looks *exactly* like *yours.*

lines.tts: But at the very end, someone will be standing with their face to the wall.
lines.cap: But at the very end, *someone* will be standing with their face to the !wall.!

lines.tts: Don't speak. Don't hold the door.
If the doors close slowly, it didn't notice you.
lines.cap: If the doors close *slowly,* it didn't *notice* *you.*

lines.tts: It isn't facing the wall anymore.
Hold your breath, and press close again.
When the doors finally shut, look in the mirror.
lines.cap: When the doors finally shut, look in the *mirror.*

lines.tts: If someone is standing in the corner behind you, with their face to the wall,
lines.cap: If someone is standing in the *corner* *behind* *you,* with their face to the wall,

lines.tts: Would you have stepped out? Tell me in the comments.
lines.cap: Would you have *stepped* *out?* Tell me in the *comments.*
